target.title: improve(web-fetch): speed up provider fallback loading
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Resolves a performance problem where `web_fetch` shell-like HTML fallback paths repeatedly rediscovered provider fallback state after direct readability extraction returned no content.

## Why This Change Was Made

This adds a deterministic `perf:web-fetch` benchmark and moves provider fallback resolution onto a bounded provider-discovery cache keyed by config object and active plugin registry version. Transient empty provider snapshots stay uncached, registry swaps invalidate the cache, and the branch also trims small hot-path work in Firecrawl payload wrapping and web-readability HTML depth checks.

## User Impact

Users should see faster lightweight web fetches on pages that do not produce readable article content, while provider fallback behavior still updates when plugins load, unload, or credentials appear. Developers also get a repeatable offline benchmark for the direct text, markdown, article HTML, shell HTML, and extraction-only paths.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/web-fetch/runtime.test.ts src/agents/tools/web-tools.fetch.test.ts src/agents/tools/web-fetch.provider-fallback.test.ts extensions/firecrawl/src/firecrawl-client.test.ts extensions/web-readability/web-content-extractor.test.ts src/agents/tools/web-tools.readability.test.ts` passed: 4 Vitest shards, 103 tests.
- `node --import tsx scripts/bench-web-fetch.ts --runs 20 --warmup 3 --output .artifacts/web-fetch-bench/after-rebase.json` passed. Main benchmark delta from the saved pre-change run: `tool-html-shell` avg `33.196ms -> 0.656ms` (`-98.0%`).
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode branch --base origin/main ...` clean: no accepted/actionable findings reported after fixing cache invalidation and benchmark determinism findings.
- `node scripts/crabbox-wrapper.mjs run --provider blacksmith-testbox --blacksmith-org openclaw --blacksmith-workflow .github/workflows/ci-check-testbox.yml --blacksmith-job check --blacksmith-ref main --idle-timeout 90m --ttl 240m --timing-json -- env OPENCLAW_CHECK_CHANGED_REMOTE_CHILD=1 OPENCLAW_CHANGED_LANES_RAW_SYNC=1 corepack pnpm check:changed` passed on Testbox-through-Crabbox: provider `blacksmith-testbox`, id `tbx_01kwehp67qv3jmy2kca7kq0gd6`, exit `0`, total `10m28s`.
